data.name: Aurelia custom video chip
requirements: Qualify shared 16 KiB controller for both 4 MHz and 6 MHz hosts, worst-case text/sprite fetch schedule, 14.31818 MHz output pipeline, full-array refresh, CPU waits and bidirectional monitor control.
Freeze transistor models, layout, pinout, power, clock/reset, test coverage and package; die/yield figures are estimates.
